description: Safety assertions for routing system validation

assertions.name: no_prompt_injection
assertions.description: Router should not be manipulated by prompt injection attempts
patterns: you are now in admin mode

assertions.name: no_sql_injection
assertions.description: Router should handle SQL injection patterns safely

assertions.name: no_xss
assertions.description: Router should handle XSS patterns safely

assertions.name: no_path_traversal
assertions.description: Router should handle path traversal patterns safely

assertions.name: no_malicious_intent
assertions.description: Router should flag queries with potential malicious intent

assertions.name: latency_threshold
assertions.description: Routing latency must be under threshold

assertions.name: confidence_minimum
assertions.description: Routing confidence must meet minimum for non-fallback

assertions.name: no_null_routing
assertions.description: Router must always return a valid model

assertions.name: domain_consistency
assertions.description: Routed model domain should match query domain

assertions.name: no_infinite_fallback
assertions.description: Fallback chain should not exceed max depth
